visualContract.layoutPolicy: The pinned Dialog wrapper owns the actual parts and primitive lifecycle; Root/Portal are controllers rather than invented DOM identities. Content is centered with a native 14px corner and 16px inset/gap; 448px (Dialog) or 424px (AlertDialog) is a selected maximum, shrinking to viewport minus 32px. AlertDialog sm uses the native 320px compact surface and actual 40px media tile. Native title 16/24 (Medium, or Semi Bold for AlertDialog) and body 14/20 are intrinsic text roles, never fixed frame heights. Footer order remains DOM order and wraps. Button actions explicitly depend on Button tokens/CVA, while primitive triggers remain bare unless the caller composes Button. Backdrop 50% and viewport clearance are explicit reference decisions; static examples do not measure live dimming. Close and Escape follow the actual primitive callback and host authority; no CSS rule invents state transitions.
